_comment: Survival Notebook API. Import in Pelican: Admin > Eggs > Import.
name: Survival Notebook API
author: hamishlester555@gmail.com
description: Runs the Survival Notebook API (Node 22, Hono, SQLite) straight from the GitHub repo. Pulls the latest main on every start.
startup: if [ -d .git ]; then git pull --ff-only || true; fi; cd api && npm ci --omit=dev && NODE_ENV=production DB_PATH=/home/container/data/notebook.db npx tsx src/index.ts

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Clones the repo into the server folder (the API lives in /api).
apt update && apt install -y git ca-certificates
cd /mnt/server
if [ -d .git ]; then
  git pull --ff-only
else
  URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
  if [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN}" ]; then URL=$(echo "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | sed "s#https://#https://x-access-token:${GIT_TOKEN}@#"); fi
  git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${URL}" /tmp/repo
  cp -a /tmp/repo/. /mnt/server/
fi
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
echo "Install finished."

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: HTTPS address of the repo, e.g. https://github.com/you/survival-notebook.git

variables.name: Git token
variables.description: Only for a private repo: a GitHub fine-grained token with read access to contents.

variables.name: JWT secret
variables.description: Signs login sessions. Make one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it logs everyone out.

variables.name: Google client ID
variables.description: The OAuth client ID from Google Cloud (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com). Needed for sign-in.
